name: people_fr
items: A 16-year-old secondary-school student in Roubaix, France, who shares a family laptop with two siblings and asks for help revising biology.
A 22-year-old apprentice electrician in Saint-Brieuc, France, who uses voice dictation because typing on his phone is slow.
A 31-year-old night-shift nursing assistant in Limoges, France, who is raising a toddler and enjoys growing herbs on her balcony.
A 44-year-old oyster farmer on Oléron Island, France, who checks weather forecasts online but rarely uses office software.
A 57-year-old unemployed former textile worker in Mulhouse, France, who is retraining in bookkeeping through an adult-education program.
A 73-year-old retired railway employee in a village near Cahors, France, who researches local history and carefully prints useful answers.
A 27-year-old doctoral student in Marseille, France, who studies marine ecology and switches between French, Arabic, and English sources.
A 39-year-old municipal librarian in Fort-de-France, Martinique, who organizes digital-literacy workshops for older residents.
A 34-year-old bicycle mechanic in Liège, Belgium, who runs a two-person repair shop and wants concise help writing customer messages.
A 48-year-old home-care worker in Charleroi, Belgium, who has irregular hours and plans low-cost meals for a blended family.
A 19-year-old art-school student in Tournai, Belgium, who has dyslexia and prefers instructions broken into short, concrete steps.
A 62-year-old Dutch-speaking civil servant in Brussels, Belgium, who writes professional French daily and asks about subtle wording choices.
A 29-year-old dairy farmer near Libramont, Belgium, who manages herd records on an old tablet and follows amateur astronomy.
A 81-year-old retired pharmacist in Namur, Belgium, who recently began using messaging apps to stay in touch with grandchildren abroad.
A 25-year-old hotel receptionist in Lausanne, Switzerland, who works rotating shifts and is learning German for career advancement.
A 41-year-old precision-machining technician in La Chaux-de-Fonds, Switzerland, who enjoys repairing vintage radios and dislikes vague explanations.
A 53-year-old primary-school teacher in Sion, Switzerland, who commutes from a mountain village and creates bilingual classroom materials.
A 68-year-old retired cleaner in Geneva, Switzerland, who speaks Portuguese at home and uses a public-library computer for administrative tasks.
A 36-year-old vineyard manager near Morges, Switzerland, who supervises seasonal workers and tracks water use during dry summers.
A 17-year-old CEGEP applicant in Saguenay, Québec, who plays wheelchair basketball and wants help comparing technical programs.
A 28-year-old community-radio producer in Rimouski, Québec, who records interviews in remote coastal towns and edits audio on a refurbished laptop.
A 45-year-old snow-removal contractor in Trois-Rivières, Québec, who co-parents two teenagers and needs practical help with invoices and schedules.
A 59-year-old Inuit health liaison in Kuujjuaq, Québec, who travels between communities and often works with unreliable internet access.
A 76-year-old retired seamstress in Québec City, Québec, who belongs to a choir and is digitizing handwritten family recipes.
A 33-year-old motorcycle-taxi dispatcher in Cotonou, Benin, who completed secondary school and manages bookings through WhatsApp.
A 50-year-old midwife in Saint-Louis, Senegal, who mentors younger colleagues and asks for plain-language patient education materials.
A 24-year-old unemployed geography graduate in Kairouan, Tunisia, who helps in the family grocery and prepares for public-service examinations.
A 38-year-old cocoa cooperative accountant in San-Pédro, Côte d’Ivoire, who supports an extended household and follows women’s football.
A 64-year-old retired postal worker in Mahajanga, Madagascar, who speaks French and Malagasy and is learning to identify coastal birds.
A 42-year-old solar-panel installer in Bukavu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, who travels to rural sites and saves technical guidance for offline use.
